## Platinum P41 SSD

Unlock the true potential of your PC with the incredible performance of our next generation PCIe 4.0 NVMe Platinum P41 SSD. Reaching up to 7,000MB/s, PCIe 4.0 enables incredibly fast speeds and we’ve meticulously designed the Platinum P41 to make full use of the technology to deliver ultimate functionality matched with long-lasting durability.

...

The Platinum P41 boasts awe-inspiring sequential read and write speeds up to 7,000MB/s and 6,500MB/s respectively.

...

## Instantaneous, 176-Layer NAND

The Platinum P41 has been loaded with SK hynix cutting-edge technology to overcome the difficulties of developing world leading memory. Adopting innovative technologies such as cell interlayer height reduction, layer variable timing control, and ultra-precise alignment has allowed the Platinum P41 to implement industry-leading 176-layer NAND flash memory.

## Platinum Tier Durability

Outperform and outlast, the Platinum P41 boasts up to an outstanding 1,200-TBW (Terabytes Written, 2TB standard) rating. We are so confident in the performance of our products each one is given our SK hynix guaranteed 5-year warranty.

SK하이닉스 Platinum P41 SSD는 업계 최고 수준의 성능으로 차세대 컴퓨팅 시스템을 완성하는 제품입니다. PCIe 4세대 NVMe 인터페이스와 176단 NAND의 한층 더 강화된 기술력을 토대로 최강의 데이터 전송 속도와 성능을 제공합니다. 이제 차원이 다른 성능을 경험해 보세요.

## 業界トップクラスの176層NAND

メモリーチップの製造において世界をリードするSKハイニックスはセル層間の高さの減少、層別の変動タイミングの制御、そして超精密整列補正などの革新的技術を成長させ続けたことで、業界トップクラス176層NANDフラッシュメモリーをPlatinum P41へと搭載可能にしました。

## プラチナ級の耐久性

より優れた性能に加えより長持ちするThe Platinum P41が誇る耐久性。1,000時間の厳格なテストを経たのち耐性1,200-TBW(最大総書き込みバイト数、２TBスタンダード)という卓越した数値を達成しています。
